description: Put a list's picks in a new order. Pass every item id exactly once, first to last, and the `revision` from list_items; if the list changed since, nothing is written and the current revision comes back. Changes the working order only; readers keep seeing the last approved version until the owner approves a list update. Private lists stay private.

list.description: Which list: exact slug, handle/slug, or id from a previous result.

order.description: Every item id in the list, in the new order.

name: reorder_items
title: Reorder a list
